gloss: frost damage; damage caused by frost

definitions.gloss: frost damage; damage caused by frost
definitions.explanation: Damage to crops, plants, or agriculture caused by frost or freezing temperatures. A significant concern for farmers, especially during late spring when unexpected frost can destroy new growth.

examples.japanese: {霜害|そうがい}で{作物|さくもつ}がやられた。
examples.english: The crops were ruined by frost damage.

examples.japanese: {遅霜|おそじも}による{霜害|そうがい}に{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Caution is needed against frost damage from late frost.

examples.japanese: {茶畑|ちゃばたけ}では{霜害|そうがい}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{送風|そうふう}ファンが{設置|せっち}されている。
examples.english: Wind fans are installed in tea fields to prevent frost damage.

notes: Composed of {霜|そう} (frost) + {害|がい} (damage, harm). Particularly affects {茶|ちゃ} (tea), {果樹|かじゅ} (fruit trees), and {野菜|やさい} (vegetables). Common collocations: {霜害|そうがい}を{受|う}ける (to suffer frost damage), {霜害|そうがい}を{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent frost damage), {霜害|そうがい}{対策|たいさく} (frost damage countermeasures). Japanese tea farmers use {防霜|ぼうそう}ファン (frost prevention fans) installed above their fields. Part of the {〜害|がい} (damage from ~) word family, like {水害|すいがい} (flood damage) and {風害|ふうがい} (wind damage).
